part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Take turns asking each other these introductory questions. Give 2-3 sentence answers.
questions: Where are you from, and what do you like most about your hometown?
How has your hometown changed since you were a child?
What is your typical daily routine like on weekdays?
Do you prefer morning routines or are you more productive at night?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe a place in your hometown that you often recommend to visitors.
points: Where this place is located
What people can do or see there
Why you enjoy going there yourself
And explain why you would recommend it to someone visiting for the first time.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss these broader questions together. Give reasons, examples, and personal perspectives.
questions: Why do many young people choose to move from small towns to big cities?
How does modern tourism affect traditional local communities?
Do you think governments should invest more in preserving historical areas or building modern infrastructure?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Ask each other about everyday technology habits.
questions: What piece of technology do you use most frequently every day?
Did you learn to use computers easily when you were younger?
Do you ever feel that you spend too much time on your smartphone?
What is an app you downloaded recently that you found useful?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe an AI tool or piece of modern technology that has changed how you study or work.
points: What kind of technology or tool it is
When and how you first started using it
What specific tasks it helps you complete
And explain whether you think it makes people more or less creative.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss the broader impact of AI and digital technology on society.
questions: Will artificial intelligence replace human teachers in the future, or will it only assist them?
What are some privacy and security concerns associated with digital technology?
How can parents ensure their children have a healthy balance with screen time?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Exchange thoughts on your studies, work, and learning preferences.
questions: Are you currently studying or working, and what do you enjoy most about it?
What subject at school was most interesting or challenging for you?
Do you prefer studying alone in quiet environments or in study groups?
Why is achieving a high IELTS score important for your future?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe an ambitious goal you have set for your academic or professional future.
points: What the goal is and when you decided on it
What steps or preparations you must take to achieve it
What difficulties you might encounter along the way
And explain how you will feel once you successfully reach this goal.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Explore broader perspectives on education systems and career trends.
questions: Is a university degree still essential for achieving success in today's job market?
How important is practical work experience compared to theoretical academic knowledge?
Do you think people in the future will change careers multiple times during their lifetimes?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Discuss weather, nature, and daily environmental habits.
questions: What is your favourite season of the year and why?
Do you enjoy spending time in nature, like parks or mountains?
Do people in your area recycle their household waste regularly?
Have you noticed changes in the weather patterns in your region over recent years?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe an environmental problem that you think is serious in your country or city.
points: What the problem is (e.g. air quality, waste, water shortage)
What causes this issue
How it impacts the everyday lives of residents
And explain what practical steps individuals or authorities could take to resolve it.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Debate global environmental responsibility and consumer habits.
questions: Who bears greater responsibility for climate change: large corporations or individual citizens?
How can schools educate children to become more environmentally conscious?
Are green technologies (like electric cars) affordable and practical enough for widespread adoption?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Share your travel experiences and views on learning foreign languages.
questions: Do you enjoy travelling to new places, and what is your favourite mode of travel?
Which country or city would you most like to visit in the near future?
Besides English, is there any other language you would love to learn?
What do you find most challenging when practicing English speaking?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe a memorable journey or trip you took that had a lasting impression on you.
points: Where you went and who accompanied you
How you travelled there
What interesting activities you did or people you met
And explain why this journey stands out in your memory.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss international culture, tourism impact, and global communication.
questions: Why is it valuable for young people to travel or live abroad before starting a career?
Can international travel help reduce cultural misunderstandings between nations?
Is there a risk that global communication might cause traditional regional languages to disappear?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Discuss healthy lifestyle habits and sports.
questions: What do you do to maintain your physical health and fitness?
Do you prefer indoor workouts or exercising in the open air?
How important is getting adequate sleep for your productivity?
What is your favourite healthy food or dish?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe a healthy habit or activity that you adopted recently.
points: What the habit or activity is
Why you decided to adopt it
How easy or difficult it was to stick with it at the beginning
And explain what positive effects you have noticed in your daily life.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss modern health challenges and society's lifestyle trends.
questions: Why are sedentary lifestyles and fast food consumption increasing in modern cities?
Should governments introduce taxes on unhealthy sugary products to encourage better diets?
How does mental well-being affect a person's physical health and work performance?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Discuss musical preferences, arts, and creative leisure activities.
questions: What genre of music do you listen to most often when you want to relax?
Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument, or would you like to?
Do you enjoy visiting art galleries, museums, or exhibitions?
Did you do drawing or handicrafts when you were in primary school?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe a piece of art, music, or a performance that deeply moved or inspired you.
points: What the piece of art or music was
Where and when you first saw or heard it
What feelings or thoughts it provoked in you
And explain why this artistic piece made such a strong impression.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss public funding for art, traditional vs digital art, and creativity.
questions: Should governments spend public money supporting artists and theatre companies?
How has digital media and AI changed the creation and appreciation of visual art?
Why do some people consider creative subjects like music just as important as mathematics?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Discuss online communication and social networking habits.
questions: How many social media platforms do you actively check during the week?
Do you prefer texting messages or having phone and video calls with friends?
Have you ever taken a digital detox or turned off notifications for a few days?
What is the most positive benefit you get from connecting with people online?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe an online community, forum, or social channel that you find valuable.
points: What the community or channel is about
How you discovered it
What kind of content or discussions take place there
And explain why you find being part of this online community worthwhile.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss the impact of algorithms, echo chambers, and online privacy on modern relationships.
questions: Do social networks bring people closer together or make genuine friendships more superficial?
How can individuals protect themselves from misinformation and biased news online?
Will virtual reality and avatars replace traditional video meetings in the near future?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Discuss urban surroundings, buildings, and green spaces in towns.
questions: What type of buildings do you see most frequently around where you live?
Do you prefer living in modern high-rise apartments or traditional houses with yards?
Are there enough parks and pedestrian areas in your neighbourhood?
What is one thing you would improve about public transport in your city?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe an impressive modern building or public structure you have visited.
points: Where this building is and what it is used for
What its architectural design looks like from the outside and inside
Why you visited this particular building
And explain what makes this structure remarkable in your opinion.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss city planning, eco-friendly green buildings, and urban population growth.
questions: Why is it essential for future cities to incorporate renewable energy and green roofs into building codes?
How does the design of public spaces influence social interaction and community happiness?
What challenges do historic cities face when trying to modernise without losing heritage?

part1.title: Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (3-4 mins)
part1.instructions: Discuss cultural celebrations, festive meals, and family holidays.
questions: What is your favourite national festival or holiday celebrated in your country?
How do families in your culture usually prepare for large holiday meals?
Do you enjoy celebrating in big crowds or having quiet family dinners?
Have you ever experienced or participated in a festival from another culture?

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn (Cue Card)
part2.instructions: One person speaks for 1-2 minutes. Click 'Start 1-Min Prep' before speaking.

cueCard.topic: Describe a memorable celebration or special family event you took part in.
points: What the celebration was for and where it happened
Who attended the event with you
What special food, music, or customs were observed
And explain why this celebration was particularly meaningful to you.

part3.title: Part 3: Two-way In-depth Discussion (4-5 mins)
part3.instructions: Discuss the preservation of cultural heritage and the commercialisation of holidays.
questions: Are younger generations losing touch with ancestral traditions, or are they reinterpreting them?
Has the commercialisation of holidays changed their original cultural meaning?
How does food serve as a bridge between different cultures in a globalised world?
